in_marathi.name: Nabhya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Navel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nabhya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Nabhah’ which means ‘Lord of the Navel’. In Hindu mythology, the navel is considered the link between the body and the cosmos, symbolizing the connection between the individual soul and the universal consciousness.

vedic_reference.note: Nabhya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nābhī' which means 'navel'. In Hindu mythology, the navel is considered the center of the body and is often associated with creation and the cycle of life. Nabhya is a name for a baby boy.
